chapter: Down in St. Bernard and the uncle
title: Life in rural St. Bernard: flooded roads, the dance hall, Tom Albert and Paul Mugnier
summary: Nelson describes the town where people traveled by boat, the dance hall with musicians brought in by boat, and musicians such as Tom Albert and Paul Mugnier from there.
